name: trackflow-monorepo
description: Monorepo de TrackFlow Tech: lógica de negocio (src/), interfaces (uis/) y servicios (services/).

scripts.install:uis: npm --prefix uis/website install && npm --prefix uis/backoffice install
scripts.typecheck:uis: npm --prefix uis/website run typecheck && npm --prefix uis/backoffice run typecheck
scripts.lint:uis: npm --prefix uis/website run lint && npm --prefix uis/backoffice run lint
scripts.build:uis: npm --prefix uis/website run build && npm --prefix uis/backoffice run build
scripts.verify: npm run check:ts && npm run typecheck:uis && npm run lint:uis && npm run build:uis
